name: vinc-app
description: Vinc desktop and web UI: two surfaces (View, Search) and sheets (Settings, Tools, Share, Import). Runs inside the Tauri shell against the local sidecar and as web Vinc against the account graph.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run test:search-temporal && npm run test:view-controls && npm run test:view-links && npm run test:view-idle && npm run test:view-layout && npm run test:view-marks && npm run test:view-loading && npm run test:view-session && npm run test:view-graph-read && npm run test:view-retained && npm run test:layout-service && npm run test:topic-conversion && npm run test:topic-detail && npm run test:role-fields && npm run test:space-picker && npm run test:role-eval && npm run test:agent-ontology && npm run test:acceptance && vite build
scripts.build:community-view: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.community-view.config.ts
scripts.test:acceptance: node --test tests/home-list.test.mjs tests/editor-insert.test.mjs tests/cm-table.test.mjs tests/doc-options.test.mjs tests/authoring-ids.test.mjs tests/extract-candidates.test.mjs tests/ask-resolve.test.mjs tests/conventions.test.mjs tests/app-update.test.mjs tests/privacy-and-web.test.mjs
